input.summary: Shell A for plots 0-3 is in parts/shell_a.mjs, and make.sh finishes with a whole build.nbt. It has piers, decks and floors, the walls with openings left as air, the partitions and both stair flights. I did not render it, run `fit`, or tick the plan.md/elements.md checklist items (I only added a note line to plan.md).
left: `mcd walk` reports every room UNREACHABLE. I did not confirm why; I assume it is because front steps, gates and doors are later parts, but the 'no way in' result is unchecked.
I did not run `mcd fit` or render, so stair rails, bed clearance and how it looks are unchecked.
`mcd check` is clean: 0 floating blocks, 0 unsupported attachments, 0 orphans.
The `stair_run` calls returned no notes, and the part's make.sh line shows no refused or off-palette lines. Whether the stairs walk to the top is unverified, because `walk` can't get in yet.
Chimney cells are left as air for the chimney part: plot 2 at x25 and x34, z12, y1..11, and plot 3 hearth x41..42, z11..14, y1..6. The plot 0 and plot 1 chimneys sit outside my footprint.
Roofs, gables above y6, window/door fittings and the quartz string course are not built here.
Plot 2 y7 floor skips the stair hole x30 z10..14 and the chimney cells, but its porch strip z7..8 is laid by a separate `floor` call.
Plot 0 piers are cobblestone, with mossy replacement picked by `rng` only on the front and back rows.

waste.what: Worked out wall-opening boxes, floor skip holes and stair/hole coordinates by hand for four houses
waste.cost: ~60 coordinate boxes, 2 retries (a stray argument crashed the save; macOS sed -i)
waste.tool: A `house_shell(g, {box, storeys, openings:[{x,y,z,w,h}], skip:[...]})` helper that derives floors, holes and plates from the plan's OPENINGS table

waste.what: Wrote local helpers floor(), partition(), plateRing()
